copy.headline: The Dallas Foundation awards nearly $2.7 million to North Texas nonprofits
copy.caption:
WATCH: The Dallas Foundation awards nearly $2.7 million to North Texas nonprofits

The Dallas Foundation has awarded nearly $2.7 million in grants to North Texas nonprofits focused on family and economic stability.

Video: CBS Texas on YouTube

story.title: The Dallas Foundation awards nearly $2.7 million to North Texas nonprofits
story.summary: The Dallas Foundation has awarded nearly $2.7 million in grants to North Texas nonprofits focused on family and economic stability. The funding will support programs addressing workforce development, food access and housing to help families overcome financial challenges.
